data.gender_notes: Rudranath is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rudra, the deity of the primal force of nature, is the god of rudimentary, raw energy. The name Rudranath means 'Lord of Rudra'. It is a name of reverence and fear, and invokes the power of Shiva, the destroyer and transformer. The name Rudranath carries the meaning “Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rudranath usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rudranath is a name of Lord Shiva, the God of destruction and transformation. It is believed that invoking the name of Rudranath brings strength, protection, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Rudranath belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rudranath total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu mythology, Lord Rudra (Shiva) is referred to as the 'Lord of Anarchy' and 'Lord of violent storms'. He is depicted as a fiery, powerful deity with blue neck due to his role in drinking the poisonous 'Halahala'. Rudranath is a name of honor and respect for this divine manifestation of Raw Power. In many Hindu rituals and practices, Rudranath is invoked to seek protection from natural calamities, disease, and to seek blessings of Shiva. This name symbolizes the fearsome and revered aspect of the deity.
data.spiritual_significance: Rudranath denotes the transcendental power of Shiva as the destroyer and transformer. The name signifies the idea of accepting the natural cycle of birth, death and rebirth. It invokes the spirit of surrendering to the higher self (Rudra or Shiva) and trusting the divine to take us through the trials and tribulations of life. Rudranath signifies the fearlessness in embracing the cycle of creation, preservation, and destruction. It reminds us of the radical transformation of the self through self-realization and serves as a reminder to remain resilient in the face of odds.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rudranath: A name symbolizing the devotional connection to Lord Shiva, thedestroyer and transformer in Hinduism, represented by the sacred mountain Rudra Himal. The divine journey to this name evokes strength, resilience, and spiritual growth.

vedic_reference.note: A common name for Lord Shiva in Hinduism. Mentioned in various Hindu scriptures and puranas.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rudra is a name of Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction. The name Rudranath carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Rudranath is likely a temple or shrine dedicated to Shiva as Rudra.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rudranath remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Radha Rudranath from Bangalore, India embodies the meaning of Rudranath - "Lord Shiva". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
